note: Passage de la Brocante place 1/4; landmark: little round bandstand kiosk with a pointed roof and a bunch of colourful balloons. First place: the flea-market passage leaves the market square behind the viewer (back = near cobbles). -er figures on the left, Ray's party (répartir) on the right; the balloon bandstand stands in the middle. Autumn leaves cooled to pass the colour gate. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
